title: Foundations, Associations, and Volunteering (1% Tax Designation)
grammar: Verbs of participation, contribution, and accounting (részesül -ban/-ben, elszámol -val/-vel)
goal: I can analyze the legal forms of Hungarian civil society: associations (egyesületek) and foundations (alapítványok).
I can use verbs governing the inessive (-ban/-ben) and instrumental (-val/-vel) in financial accountability.
I can explain the 1% personal income tax designation mechanism supporting NGOs and churches.
